verdict.rationale: The evidence documents single-item API operations, such as creating one candidate or adding profile fields to a candidate by ID, plus collection read endpoints. Nothing documents a bulk-action capability, either a UI bulk action or a batch API endpoint, that acts on many items at once. Listing collections and merging candidates are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
